description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference 24/3269/FUL dated 22/08/25 for 'Change of use and alterations to the existing building to provide a childrens day nursery (Use Class E) including a single storey extension and new front entrance following demolition of the existing garage. Associated changes to hard and soft landscaping, provision of off-street parking, refuse storage and cycle parking.' Amendments include: Addition of a slate covered pitched roof and dormers to match existing; Addition of one Velux window to the west facing pitched; Removal of existing glazed roof access to be replaced with a flat roof; Addition of an Automated Opening Vent (AOV) on the existing roof; Addition of rainwater pipes and hoppers; Relocation of the extension's kitchen window; Replacement of existing UPVC windows and doors with aluminium frames; Addition of Air Intake Units and ventilation louvres to roofs and facades; Minor internal layout changes to the extension; Changes to the wording of Condition 19 to remove the word 'pelican' in relation to the crossing on The Ridgeway
